sentences.text: Nestle SA has sharpened its portfolio around four core businesses, Coffee, Petcare, Nutrition and Food & Snacks, which receive prioritised resources and a simpler organisation.

sentences.quote:
Coffee and Petcare sit at the centre of its long-term growth ambitions.

Coffee's evolving far beyond its traditional role as a hot breakfast beverage, with Nestle seeing significant opportunities in cold coffee
sentences.text: Coffee and Petcare sit at the centre of long-term growth ambitions, with opportunities in cold coffee, ready-to-drink formats and functional beverages, alongside pet therapeutics and under-penetrated pet food markets in Asia.

Volume-led growth is the stated engine: first-half 2026 organic growth was 3.6% with real internal growth of 1.5%, and full-year guidance of 3-4% organic growth, an improved trading operating margin and free cash flow above CHF 9 billion was maintained.

sentences.quote: Emerging markets recorded organic growth of 5.6%, comprising 2.8% RIG and 2.8% pricing. Excluding Greater China, emerging-market organic growth reached 7.1%
sentences.text: Emerging markets grew 5.6% organically, and 7.1% excluding Greater China.
Cost savings of CHF 600 million were delivered in the first half, with about 16,000 job cuts planned.

thesis_pillars.text: Nestle SA has sharpened its portfolio around four core businesses, Coffee, Petcare, Nutrition and Food & Snacks, which receive prioritised resources and a simpler organisation. Coffee and Petcare sit at the centre of long-term growth ambitions, with opportunities in cold coffee, ready-to-drink formats and functional beverages, alongside pet therapeutics and under-penetrated pet food markets in Asia. Emerging markets grew 5.6% organically, and 7.1% excluding Greater China.
